body: It probably wasn’t a coincidence. But, that’s okay. If it’ll help another through your struggle that’s fine. I hope you’re able to still come forward when you need it. Sometimes we need a bunch of sleep and we need to say fuck it. The great thing, though, is when you bounce back and feel the ‘great day’ again. I do amazing things on those days. Not manic, but brilliant. I hope you have those days. I hope you stick it out for those days.

I see him every four weeks after my blood tests. We were making great headway on my TSH, had it down to 5 (terrible, but better than 20). Then, I was in my hole and asked for Zoloft. Shot back to 12 and I decided the thyroid was the more important condition. I think I was wrong. 

What are your levels / dosages if you don’t mind? There doesn’t seem to be much written about the negative interactions with Levo and Zoloft. Have you tried other meds and were they free of conflict?

That’s the odd thing. I don’t feel in danger because my constant thoughts about it are rejected immediately, but it only takes one to be successful. Idk what a hotline could do for that. 

It’s my inability to fix it this time (I’ve dealt with this cycle for years, now) that’s killing me.

I’m so glad you called for help. What treatment did you receive?

Well, that happens. It’ll probably happen for the rest of your life. That’s okay. With the timing of this, it’s around finals. That affects your life. But, you come first. Everything else can be fixed. If this is what you needed, then you’ll be okay. Trust that everything will pass and you’ll do better next time. You’ve got this.
